# Pull Request

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.vi.md)

## Purpose
What problem does this change solve?

## Validation
- [ ] Rails tests and system tests pass.
- [ ] Brakeman and RuboCop pass.
- [ ] Bilingual docs and links are checked.
- [ ] Changes to authentication, enrollment, vector provenance, or permissions have regression tests.
- [ ] No secrets or user face images are included.

## Migration and service impact
Specify PostgreSQL migrations, Devise session impact, external Modal/R2/SMTP interactions, and whether live integration evidence is available.
